verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding agent and workbench, so having the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches and open pull requests is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents none of these: the only Git mentions are reports about workspace or Git data being uploaded, which say nothing about the agent performing Git or PR workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
